# P36.58 — Task export v2

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/401_P36.58__task-export-v2.md` (manifest row 401, K11 RQ-01)
**Requirement ids stamped:** SIG-RQ-001, SIG-RQ-003, SIG-RQ-005, SIG-RQ-006 (owner); SIG-UI-039, SIG-UI-040, SIG-ENG-042 (cited)
**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · **`live_verification=false`** — no `live:`-leg, no OM-20 production mutation.

## What lands

- **The v2 card record** (`web/research_queue.json`, `sig.queue-card/2`): `task_id`, trigger kind/ref plus the resolved trigger *detail* (coverage predicate + absence kind + sources searched / contradiction type + severity / edge access kind + dates — `{resolves: false}` when the materialized row is absent), `predicate_ids` naming the missing predicate(s) (SIG-RQ-005), `subject_label` + `subject_url` from the shared P35.29 label registry (typed `Record #<hash4>` fallback — never a raw UUID, SIG-RQ-003), §4.3 jurisdiction attribution with a named basis (`place` + `place_basis`: task_jurisdiction | subject_place | dossier_placement | tenant | recorded | unplaced), status/disposition/`generated_at`/detector version, and the K11 §3 handle + per-type title (SIG-RQ-001).
- **`tasks/data/task_codes.toml`** — the handle-code registry: per-type `[a-z]{2,10}` mnemonic, plain-language type label and title template for all 34 §33.2 catalog types plus the two catalog-pending RQ-02 types.
- **`tasks/data/gap_routing.toml`** — the explicit predicate→lane table (SIG-RQ-005): every §32.1 peer-class `tracked` predicate routes `research` | `campaign` | `metric` with optional route/template/grain — replaces the retired substring match as the routing authority; `tasks/routing.py` loads both with closed-vocabulary validation.
- **Lanes (SIG-RQ-006 / D-K11-1):** per-object coverage field gaps follow the table — OSM-mappable predicates aggregate into `M-<place>-<field>-<hash>` campaigns by (place, predicate) with member lists; registry-only fields stay out of the queue surface entirely (coverage metrics carry them) with the count named in queue_meta — never silently dropped.
- **Shards:** `web/tasks/<lane>/<place>.jsonl.gz` per lane and place, ≤25 MB per part (SIG-RQ-010), byte-deterministic gzip.
- **`web/task_handles_history.json`** (`sig.handles-history/1`): `/task/<uuid>/` → `/task/<handle>/` id-aliases for the JUR-05 redirect generator + the honest empty first-release rename history.
- **`sig/analytics-queue-meta/2`:** lane counts, type/assignee facets, per-place totals, the shard index, handle grammar + card schema.
- **Copy fix (RC-6):** `coverage_hole`'s closing-condition template names the subject, not "the jurisdiction".

## Explicitly not in this row

- The detector-side re-mint (`retention_unknown`/`sharing_unknown` catalog types, `research_task.predicate_ids` column, per-camera row supersession) — RQ-02's scope (P37.35); the routing table names the target types so that lands as data review.
- Task/queue pages, campaign pages, `/task/<uuid>/` redirect routes — RQ-03a/b (P36.61/62); this row emits the artifacts they read.
- Evidence-artifact `E-` handles — EV-02 (P36.60).
